## Fewer storage reads while streaming
When a mixture-of-experts model is bigger than the memory you give it, Astronomical reads the experts each word needs from the SSD. This release keeps whole only as many layers as still leave every other layer a fair share of memory, and sizes those shares from the memory they actually have, so far fewer experts have to be read again.
- Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B 8-bit Astro Atlas at 17.6 GB: 21 to 49 experts read from the SSD per word, down from 71 to 109, and 32.1 tokens a second with nothing held in the macOS file cache, up from 22.2. - The 4-bit OptiQ build at an 11 GB limit: 33.3 tokens a second, up from 25.1. - Replies are word for word the same as before. - Each reply's hits, misses and bytes read from the SSD now show in `/v1/experts` and in the log.
## New in the catalog
- **Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-MLX-8bit-vision with its DFlash2 drafter**, for draft trees on the highest-precision Ornith build.
## OpenCode
- `astronomical launch opencode` writes OpenCode's current configuration format and tells OpenCode the model's real context window. `astronomical launch codex` now declares the context window too. - A new OpenCode plugin keeps every model Astronomical serves in OpenCode's model picker: `opencode plugin add opencode-astronomical`. It is published separately from the app; see the [local API page](https://getastronomical.com/local-api.html).
## Also
- The model engine is now built as several smaller parts. Nothing changes in what it does.
Your models, chats and settings are kept across the update. Requires an Apple silicon Mac with macOS 14 or later.
Astronomical 0.2.119 is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the direct download and the signed Sparkle update feed.
